The Opportunity

You're investing in the brand that already leads this category.

For decades, a basic shower meant buying, storing, and replacing four separate products. We patented a single sponge that replaces all of them, and the market answered: shelf space in the largest retailers in the country, and customers who reorder for years. The authority in this category is already established. The door to own a piece of it is still open.

Patents, margins, and a format we invented ourselves. Beyond the original buffer, we've built a full self-care platform: hand and body wash, lotions, candles, and gift sets across a dozen signature scents, so a single investment compounds across many products at once.

Licensing, Live On Shelf

Six major brands now sell our patented format under their own name.

The Licensing Engine

A parent buys Bluey. A collector buys Sanrio. A fan buys the Liquid Death skull. Every one of them is buying our patent.

Six of the biggest names in entertainment license the Body Wash Infused Buffer® and release it as their own product, in their own packaging, cut into their own character. The shopper sees Batman. What they take home is our patented format. Each partner brings an audience we never had to buy, and funds the campaign that reaches it.

Common Questions

What investors usually ask us.

Reg CF is an SEC framework that lets private companies raise capital from the general public, not just accredited investors. It's the same rule that lets everyday people invest small amounts in early-stage and growth companies through a registered funding portal.

Any US resident 18 or older can typically invest in a Reg CF offering, regardless of income or net worth, though your total investment across all Reg CF deals in a 12 month period may be capped based on your income and net worth. Our minimum is $500. Investors at that level also receive $100 in free product, with better perks at higher tiers, up to $250 in limited-edition product at the $1,000 level and beyond. Full details will be confirmed in our Form C once the offering opens.

The exact security type (such as equity, a revenue share, or a convertible note) will be specified in our Form C filing once the offering is live. Joining this list does not commit you to anything. It simply means we'll notify you the moment full offering terms are public.

No. This page is for testing the waters only. We are gauging investor interest ahead of our official Reg CF offering. No funds are being accepted, and no commitment is created by signing up here.

As with any private company investment, you could lose some or all of your money, and shares are typically illiquid with no guaranteed resale market. We encourage every investor to review our full risk disclosures in the Form C before making a decision.
